canonical_bestiary_enrichment.scope: 11 existing exact source race matches plus36 existing source ID/name/render and accepted-client staticdata matches;22 new exact canonical proofs. Donor/source IDs unchanged, blank Wiki IDs remain unspecified. One source name typo, one numerical Wiki ID conflict and one missing canonical Bestiary label remain unqualified. No absent compact MATCH inference.
